SREEDHAR N.P

Email: npsree91@gmail.com https://www.linkedin.com/in/sreedhar-np-2b925117/

SENIOR FINANCE ANALYST

Phone: 9633372449

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY Certified ScrumMaster and Certified SAFe 6.0 scrum master with close to 8 years of financial services experience, including asset servicing, hedge fund accounting, and loan syndication. Proven ability to lead Agile teams, facilitate Scrum ceremonies, and drive continuous improvement. Combines strong financial acumen with a servant-leader mindset to deliver high-impact, value-driven results in fast-paced, regulated environments. Recently trained in SAP FICO and SAP S/4HANA, and eager to leverage financial expertise to contribute in SAP environments while growing into a functional consulting role.

CORPORATE WORK HISTORY

Senior Associate 2 SA2, Fund Services Trade Operations, 01/2023 to 09/2024 Intertrust Group ( CSC Group) - Bengaluru Asset servicing- loan operation:

Liaised with agent banks and custodian banks to acquire swift payment details and information regarding various trade economics. Thorough and accurate verification of funding memos and processing of agent notices. Geneva was leveraged to handle the end-to-end process of rollovers and prepayments, from contract creation to deal rollover execution, and ensured accurate processing of agent bank notices for rollover interest, rate sets, paydowns, facility increases, and borrowings. Perform daily and monthly reconciliations of cash balances against profit and loss (P&L) statements. Leveraged expertise in Geneva, Wall Street office and ClearPar to streamline the monitoring of trade settlement activities. Prepared daily reports: rolled/unrolled contracts, coupon frequency, duplicate pay downs, and break reports. Daily handling of team resource distribution to ensure there is optimal workflow which ensured 100% SLA. Data mapping - Markit WSO IDs were leveraged to facilitate the data mapping of manual loans to auto loans within the Geneva portfolio management system.

Applications/Vendor Proficiency : External: Geneva, Markit Wall street office and ClearPar. Internal: VU reconciliation(Viteos). Highlights : Played a pivotal role in the formation and expansion of the bank debt team, growing it from a 2-member group to a highly skilled 10+ member team.

Senior Finance Analyst, Northern Trust Hedge Fund Accounting (Global Fixed Income and Alternatives Team), 03/2018 to 01/2023 Northern Operating Services Pvt. Ltd - Bengaluru

Responsible for providing comprehensive fund accounting support to hedge fund clients. Supporting Bank debt and Fixed Income processes by understanding their complex structure. Understanding lifecycle of syndicated bank loans, swaps and total return swaps in bank debt to apply same in processing. Assisting reference data team for security setup creation and adding those to Wall Street office and Global browser.

Responsibilities in Bank Debt Process

Daily trade booking of bank loans and swaps into the Wall Street office using the Global Browser. Ensured accurate trade affirmation through clear par verification. Facilitated trade settlements through the review and processing of funding memos from agent banks. Processed agent bank notices related to syndicated loans, including interest payments, rate sets, payment-in-kind (PIK) transactions, facility increases, and principal paydowns. Performed cash and positional reconciliation for the Wall Street office positions, verifying internal records against broker-provided data Accurate processing extended to adding and mapping securities into Wall Street Office and Global Browser.

Responsibilities in Fixed Income process

Performed Mortgage-Backed Securities trade variance checks with help of Bloomberg data. Accrued interest and principal checks on daily traded collateralized mortgage obligation tranches and Pools with help of detailed research in Bloomberg and Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation. Performed Original & Current face check on monthly and mid monthly payments with help of Bloomberg. Monthly accrual checks - Accrued interest checks and preparation of Cash Flow analysis report. Responsibilities extended to the reconciliation of accrued cash balances as well as the preparation of the custody break file report. The scope of fixed income instruments covered included CMO tranches, corporate bonds, government bonds, convertible bonds, pooled securities, and mortgage bonds.

Applications/Vendor Proficiency : External - Bloomberg, Clear par, Wall Street office, Depository trust and clearing corporation. NT platform – Reference data workstation, Rec Dash Board, Global Browser, Buy Sell Editor, Hedge Fund Passport, Corporate action poster and Cash poster. Highlights - Outperformed the given target and SLA consecutively achieving 100% quality score and Demonstrated excellence in colleague training, consistently receiving positive feedback.

CERTIFICATIONS AND COURSES

Certified ScrumMaster® - 04/27/2025 issued by Scrum Alliance, Inc. Certified safe® 6.0 scrum master -SAFe Certified SSM issued by Scaled Agile Inc AI for Scrum Masters - issued by Scrum Alliance, Inc. Agile Scrum Master on 05/02/2025 on Udemy. GST certification NACEN & Prime Academy. National center for labour and learning Sales Tax Practitioner . Business correspondent & Business facilitator conforming to national skill Qualifications - Framework Level -3 (NSDC- BFSI). Pursuing SAP FICO/ECC and SAP S/4HANA.

NON CORPORATE WORK HISTORY

Accountant Assistant 06/2013 to 06/2014 STP Associates - Thrissur, India

Responsible for managing sales tax accounting for small businesses and vendors. Responsible for the full cycle of sales tax accounting, producing accurate journals, ledgers, and balance sheets for small business financial reporting. Complete filing tasks while proactively offering sales tax consultation to vendors and small businesses, fostering compliance and streamlining tax management.

Clerical Trainee 08/2012 to 03/2013 Professional Academy - Thrissur, India

Performed a range of clerical tasks and managed front office operations, which involved the critical function of gathering and disseminating important information to relevant parties.

APPLICATIONS HANDLED

SKILLS

Geneva Wall Street office Bloomberg Markit

SAP DTCC ClearPar

Agile Prompt engineering Jira

Confluence Project coordination

INTERNSHIPS

Edelweiss Stock Broking Ltd 27th June 2016 to 26th August 2016

Role: Finance Internship

Landmark Group 11th January 2016 to 10th February 2016

Role: Accounts Internship

EDUCATION

Master of Commerce (M.Com)

Madurai Kamaraj University - Bengaluru , 06/2018 to 01/2020

Post Graduate Diploma in Management, Finance & International Business

ISBR Business School - Bengaluru , 06/2015 to 10/2017

ACCOMPLISHMENTS

Received the I Core - Gem Award from Intertrust CSC for consistently exceeding performance expectations.

sections.label: Summary
sections.text:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY Certified ScrumMaster and Certified SAFe 6.0 scrum master with close to 8 years of financial services experience, including asset servicing, hedge fund accounting, and loan syndication. Proven ability to lead Agile teams, facilitate Scrum ceremonies, and drive continuous improvement. Combines strong financial acumen with a servant-leader mindset to deliver high-impact, value-driven results in fast-paced, regulated environments. Recently trained in SAP FICO and SAP S/4HANA, and eager to leverage financial expertise to contribute in SAP environments while growing into a functional consulting role.
CORPORATE WORK HISTORY
Senior Associate 2 SA2, Fund Services Trade Operations, 01/2023 to 09/2024 Intertrust Group ( CSC Group) - Bengaluru Asset servicing- loan operation:
Liaised with agent banks and custodian banks to acquire swift payment details and information regarding various trade economics. Thorough and accurate verification of funding memos and processing of agent notices. Geneva was leveraged to handle the end-to-end process of rollovers and prepayments, from contract creation to deal rollover execution, and ensured accurate processing of agent bank notices for rollover interest, rate sets, paydowns, facility increases, and borrowings. Perform daily and monthly reconciliations of cash balances against profit and loss (P&L) statements. Leveraged expertise in Geneva, Wall Street office and ClearPar to streamline the monitoring of trade settlement activities. Prepared daily reports: rolled/unrolled contracts, coupon frequency, duplicate pay downs, and break reports. Daily handling of team resource distribution to ensure there is optimal workflow which ensured 100% SLA. Data mapping - Markit WSO IDs were leveraged to facilitate the data mapping of manual loans to auto loans within the Geneva portfolio management system.
Applications/Vendor Proficiency : External: Geneva, Markit Wall street office and ClearPar. Internal: VU reconciliation(Viteos). Highlights : Played a pivotal role in the formation and expansion of the bank debt team, growing it from a 2-member group to a highly skilled 10+ member team.
Senior Finance Analyst, Northern Trust Hedge Fund Accounting (Global Fixed Income and Alternatives Team), 03/2018 to 01/2023 Northern Operating Services Pvt. Ltd - Bengaluru
Responsible for providing comprehensive fund accounting support to hedge fund clients. Supporting Bank debt and Fixed Income processes by understanding their complex structure. Understanding lifecycle of syndicated bank loans, swaps and total return swaps in bank debt to apply same in processing. Assisting reference data team for security setup creation and adding those to Wall Street office and Global browser.
Responsibilities in Bank Debt Process
Daily trade booking of bank loans and swaps into the Wall Street office using the Global Browser. Ensured accurate trade affirmation through clear par verification. Facilitated trade settlements through the review and processing of funding memos from agent banks. Processed agent bank notices related to syndicated loans, including interest payments, rate sets, payment-in-kind (PIK) transactions, facility increases, and principal paydowns. Performed cash and positional reconciliation for the Wall Street office positions, verifying internal records against broker-provided data Accurate processing extended to adding and mapping securities into Wall Street Office and Global Browser.
Responsibilities in Fixed Income process
Performed Mortgage-Backed Securities trade variance checks with help of Bloomberg data. Accrued interest and principal checks on daily traded collateralized mortgage obligation tranches and Pools with help of detailed research in Bloomberg and Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation. Performed Original & Current face check on monthly and mid monthly payments with help of Bloomberg. Monthly accrual checks - Accrued interest checks and preparation of Cash Flow analysis report. Responsibilities extended to the reconciliation of accrued cash balances as well as the preparation of the custody break file report. The scope of fixed income instruments covered included CMO tranches, corporate bonds, government bonds, convertible bonds, pooled securities, and mortgage bonds.
Applications/Vendor Proficiency : External - Bloomberg, Clear par, Wall Street office, Depository trust and clearing corporation. NT platform – Reference data workstation, Rec Dash Board, Global Browser, Buy Sell Editor, Hedge Fund Passport, Corporate action poster and Cash poster. Highlights - Outperformed the given target and SLA consecutively achieving 100% quality score and Demonstrated excellence in colleague training, consistently receiving positive feedback.
Business correspondent & Business facilitator conforming to national skill Qualifications - Framework Level -3 (NSDC- BFSI). 
Responsible for the full cycle of sales tax accounting, producing accurate journals, ledgers, and balance sheets for small business 
Complete filing tasks while proactively offering sales tax consultation to vendors and small businesses, fostering compliance and 
Performed a range of clerical tasks and managed front office operations, which involved the critical function of gathering and 
Received the I Core - Gem Award from Intertrust CSC for consistently exceeding performance expectations.
